leadText:
A Waitress (Japanese: ウエートレス Waitress) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in the Generation IV games. They are generally depicted as young girls or young women in typical waitress clothing. They are the female counterpart of the and classes.

In Pokémon Legends: Z-A, Waiters often use - and Pokémon, or Pokémon associated with food.

====Pokémon====
 

 

 

==In the TCG==
 
 
Waitress was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Mega Evolution Series (the Japanese MEGA Series). It was first released in the Japanese product before debuting in the expansion, with artwork by Cona Nitanda. This card allows the player to look at the top 6 cards of their deck and attach a they find there to 1 of their Pokémon.
 

==Trivia==
